summary: Friday's session kept the dollar firm near 102.2 and 10-year real yields pinned around 2.87%, pressuring gold back under its 50-day average and into fear territory. Treasuries extended their slide, with TLT off roughly 4% over two weeks, yet equities shrugged it off, holding gains as volatility stayed subdued near 14.8. Bitcoin's one-month advance kept crypto in mild greed despite choppier short-term trade.
tweet: Dollar and real yields pinned gold in fear Friday while a steepening bond selloff left stocks unbothered and crypto still in greed.
